documentationCorrections.decision27vs34: The historical PR E wording said 27 canonical codes, while its table already had 28 rows. The current PSRTrigger enum has exactly 34 members, getPSRReasonCategory.test.ts asserts all 34, and current runtime support includes the six previously omitted codes: domino_effect, swamp_bog_down, airmek_landing, controlled_sideslip, flanking_and_turning, and out_of_control. Because these six are already accepted and represented by live code, the canonical spec was synchronized to 34 rather than preserving the stale 27 count or expanding runtime scope.
